# appraisal value

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:appraisalValue`](gmeow-appraisalValue.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/appraisalValue>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/affect`](../../slices/affect.md)

The dimensional reading, on whatever scale the appraising tradition declares (a rubric's [`ScoreScale`](../classes/gmeow-ScoreScale.md) when the rubrics facility is loaded; plain decimals otherwise — soft reference, never a dependency). At most one per appraisal, with its dimension (SHACL). Constitutive of this one cell — divergent readings are divergent Appraisals, not extra values.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Appraisal`](../classes/gmeow-Appraisal.md) -> [`xsd:decimal`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:appraisalValue`](gmeow-appraisalValue.md) from [`gmeow:Appraisal`](../classes/gmeow-Appraisal.md) to [`xsd:decimal`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
